description: This file defines React components for rendering Markdown content with advanced features such as math formulas, syntax highlighting, Mermaid diagrams, and code copying. It includes components like Markdown, MarkdownContent, PreCode, Mermaid, and helper functions for parsing and rendering Markdown with plugins.

methods.name: Mermaid
methods.description: React component that renders a Mermaid diagram from code, with error handling and option to view SVG in a new window.

methods.name: PreCode
methods.description: Component that renders preformatted code blocks, detects Mermaid code, and renders diagrams accordingly.

methods.name: escapeDollarNumber
methods.description: Function that escapes dollar signs followed by digits in text to prevent misinterpretation in Math rendering.

methods.name: escapeBrackets
methods.description: Function that escapes or converts bracketed math expressions in Markdown content.

methods.name: _MarkDownContent
methods.description: Internal memoized component that processes and renders Markdown content with plugins and custom components.
